name: Kakigori
description: Finely shaved ice mounded in a bowl and drenched with flavored syrups like matcha, strawberry, or condensed milk.
ingredients: a handful of sliced scallion whites
a pinch of cracked black pepper
a generous handful of daikon radish
a handful of fresh chives, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ramen noodles and cracked black pepper until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the toasted sesame oil with the dashi stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 0 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with mitsuba or a dusting of mirin.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
Bring your toasted sesame oil to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
